props.takeaway: Pause, check, report: one click does the rest
props.source: Information security policy, Quillon Freight (internal policy, fictional)

items.title: Check
items.text: Who really sent it? Hover over the link: where does it go?

items.title: Report
items.text: Press Report in Outlook. It goes to the desk and leaves your inbox.

items.title: Clicked? Call 4444
items.text: Typed a password or opened a file? Call the security desk at once.

lines.speaker: guide
lines.text: So, an email surprises you. Pause: don't click, reply or forward.

lines.speaker: guide
lines.text: Check who really sent it, and where the link goes. Then press Report.

lines.speaker: guide
lines.text: Clicked, or typed a password? Call the desk on 4444, straight away.
